entities.summary: Yodsanan Sor Nanthachai or Yodsanan Sityodtong a.k.a. Yodsanan 3-K Battery is a Thai professional Muay Thai fighter, professional boxer, and mixed martial artist. Yodsanan is a former WBA super featherweight champion, a title he held from 2002 to 2005.
